related_questions.question: Are eye infections a symptom of COVID?
related_questions.snippet: Yes. COVID can cause eye infections. Like many other viruses, COVID can cause conjunctivitis, or “pink eye.” This happens when the virus infects the outer layer of the eye, called the conjunctiva. COVID conjunctivitis is the most common eye problem caused by the COVID virus.

related_questions.question: How to treat COVID pink eye at home?

text_blocks.snippet: To manage mild symptoms of pink eye associated with COVID-19 at home, you can use cool or warm compresses, artificial tears, and over-the-counter pain relievers. Avoid rubbing your eyes and stop wearing contact lenses. If symptoms worsen or persist, consult a doctor for potential prescription treatments.
snippet_highlighted_words: use cool or warm compresses, artificial tears, and over-the-counter pain relievers

list.title: Cool or Warm Compresses:
list.snippet: Apply a clean, cool or warm compress to your closed eyelids for a few minutes at a time, several times a day. Use separate cloths for each eye to prevent spreading the infection.

list.title: Artificial Tears:
list.snippet: Use over-the-counter lubricating eye drops (artificial tears) to soothe dryness and irritation.

list.title: Pain Relief:
list.snippet: Over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen or ibuprofen can help with discomfort and inflammation.

list.title: Avoid Irritants:
list.snippet: Steer clear of irritants like smoke, wind, and air conditioning, which can worsen symptoms.

list.title: Contact Lenses:
list.snippet: If you wear contacts, switch to glasses until your pink eye clears up to avoid reinfection.

list.title: Severe Symptoms:
list.snippet: If your pink eye is accompanied by severe pain, vision changes, or excessive discharge, consult a doctor promptly.

list.title: Persistent Symptoms:
list.snippet: If home remedies don't improve your symptoms within a few days, seek professional medical advice.

list.title: Weakened Immune System:
list.snippet: If you have a weakened immune system, it's crucial to consult a doctor for appropriate treatment.
